scraped.scraped_description: We use some essential cookies to make this service work.

name: Gender Pay Gap Service
tagline: Search and compare gender pay gap data
news_articles: BBC News - Gender pay gap reporting begins
Guardian - UK gender pay gap data now public
Reuters - UK launches gender pay gap transparency tool
academic_citations: Blau, F. D., & Kahn, L. M. (2017). The gender wage gap: Extent, trends, and explanations. Journal of Economic Literature, 55(3), 789-865.
Acker, J. (2006). Inequality regimes: Gender, class, and race in organizations. Gender & Society, 20(4), 441-464.
policy_outcomes: Mandatory gender pay gap reporting for employers with 250+ employees
outcome_methodology: Regulatory compliance tracking and public transparency mechanism
documented_limitations: Data limited to employers with 250+ employees
Does not capture intersectional pay gaps
Snapshot reporting rather than longitudinal tracking
curation_criteria: Employer size threshold (250+ employees), annual reporting requirement, standardized data submission format
controversies: Criticism for high reporting threshold excluding small and medium enterprises
Debate over effectiveness in closing actual pay gaps
legal_regulatory_issues: Equality Act 2010 (Gender Pay Gap Information) Regulations 2017
political_relevance_summary: Gender Pay Gap Service addresses government transparency and accountability. Search and compare gender pay gap data.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides data, research, or monitoring capabilities for civic purposes.

generalizability_notes: Could be adapted to other national contexts with localization. Proprietary or closed-source; replication requires licensing.
